name: coop-presentation-guards
description: Guard optional Harry noise listeners and Spongify effect references; restrict landed cursor changes to the owning viewport. Preserve all landing movement, damage, noise and pad interactions.
format_note: ASCII JSON. Encode old/new strings as latin-1; preserve LF bytes. Apply only to a marked development copy.
apply_policy: Whole-file source/result hashes and unique byte anchors are mandatory.
Apply after restore-legacy-gameplay; the build coordinator must preserve dependency ordering and repeated-build idempotence.
scope: Optional HearHarryRecipient callback is skipped only when absent; every existing MakeNoise call remains unchanged.
StopSpongifyEffects disables each effect only when that effect exists.
Only the two SpellCursor.SetLOSDistance calls in PlayerWalking.Landed require Player, local Viewport and SpellCursor.
No changes to Landed damage, SpongifyPad selection, physics, animation, sound, ShakeView or AutoHitAreaEffect.
StartAiming/makeTarget/native fire-bit guards belong to HPCoopHarry and are outside this base-source recipe.

replacements.old:
for( i = 0; i < NUM_SPONGIFY_FX; i++ )
		SpongifyFX[i].bEmit = false;
